title: Beyond the Gates Spoilers Thursday, July 30: Dani Walks in on Nicole and Kial in Bed; Bill's Caught in the Middle as Hayley Argues with Chelsea and Naomi; Martin Grills Kat About her Investigating Lynette - NewsBreak
text:
By CP Bialois ,
5 hours ago Beyond the Gates spoilers for Thursday, July 30 reveals Dani Dupree ( Karla Mosely ) will walk in on a, um, revealing sight of Nicole Richardson ( Daphnée Duplaix ) and Kial Rollins ( Greg Vaughan ) in bed.
Bill Hamilton ( Timon Kyle Durrett ) is caught in the middle when Hayley Lawson ( Marquita Goings ) gets into a fight with Chelsea Hamilton ( RhonniRose Mantilla ) and Naomi Hawthorne ( Arielle Prepetit ), while Martin Richardson ( Brandon Claybon ) grills Kat Richardson ( Colby Muhammad ) after her conversation with Smitty Smith ( Mike Manning ) about Lynette Wise ( Dominique Madison ).
Key Highlights: Dani walks in on Nicole and Kial in bed. Bill’s in the middle when Hayley fights with Chelsea and Naomi. Martin questions Kat about her conversation with Smitty.
Plenty to see here! Beyond the Gates spoilers show Dani will have perfect timing when she walks into Nicole’s bedroom to find her in bed with Kial. It looks like she’s going to put her key to work since she has something she wants to talk about. She probably can’t believe Nicole wouldn’t answer her calls or texts, so why not walk right on in?
She’ll get an eyeful as the two will be in bed, but Nicole will handle it well. She’ll take it as high praise when Dani practically drools over Kial. As to what Dani wanted, does it even matter? Let the sisters have some fun for now. Things ill blow up soon enough.
Hayley defends her plot Well, it looks like Hayley won’t like Chelsea and Naomi coming around to visit Bill. Especially when they are looking to help him heal. Their judgmental attitudes won’t help, and it’ll put Hayley on the defensive. She doesn’t want Bill getting better, but she’ll also resent their implication that she’d rathe have a manicure than take care of he husband.
Of course, the reason for their visit will be suffering as Bill will be caught between the two sides. It won’t end well as after his daughters leave, Hayley will turn on him. He’ll refuse to ban his daughters from his house, and Hayley will take offense to the term ‘his’. Well, he paid for it and she’s trying to steal it, do yeah, it’s kinda his.
Kat ignores Martin’s concerns Kat will happily share all she knows about Lynette with Smitty, and he’ll appreciate her input. He’ll also be concerned about her safety if she keeps digging. It’s a concern Martin will have as well. He’ll either overhear them talking or Smitty will tell him.
This won’t sit well with Matin and he’ll want to know what she’s planning to do and how much trouble is she willing to get into. He knows she doesn’t think about danger first and just walks straight in, but that won’t matter. She’s going to do what she wants to and no one will stop her.
Will Bill finally have enough of Hayley and kick her out? Let us know in the comments below.
